pilot_role: Na/Cu(001) is the development pilot, not a randomly selected validation-system observation.

maximum_separation.arc_efficiency_maximum: maximum of eta(chi); not computed by this route
maximum_separation.reaction_path_saddle: maximum energy along the converged minimum-energy path
maximum_separation.kinetic_turnover_maximum: requires an independent friction/damping series and independent rates; not assumed

stages.bulk: Reuse the completed 120-SCF matrix, execute a six-SCF 80 Ry/16^3 holdout EOS, and select the smallest candidate satisfying joint lattice and energy gates.
stages.slab: Run the full primitive Cu(001) thickness-vacuum-k matrix under ESM bc1, fit thickness-dependent slab energies, retain at least seven layers for one-sided mobility, and record a periodic comparison only as a diagnostic.
stages.clean_surface: Relax the symmetric clean slab in z and reproduce the final energy with a separate fixed-geometry SCF.
stages.pseudopotential: Verify immutable archive and UPF hashes, read Na cutoffs from authoritative SSSP cutoffs.json metadata, and calculate an isolated spin-polarized Na reference.
stages.adsorption: Run hollow, bridge, and top starts at three heights under primary and expanded one-sided substrate-mobility models. Unexpected minima trigger mechanism revision rather than coercion.
stages.paths: Converge ordinary NEB at 5, 7, and 9 images for both mobility models. CI-NEB is initialized from the selected ordinary path coordinates.
stages.mobility: Compare primary and expanded full-path barriers. A difference above 5 meV gives HOLD and requires a larger preregistered mobility region.
stages.saddle: Build mass-weighted Hessians for Na-only, Na+4Cu, and Na+8Cu regions at 0.02 and 0.04 A. Require index-one saddle behavior, active-region prefactor convergence, and 3D downhill return to distinct endpoint basins.
stages.sensitivity: Evaluate fixed-geometry cutoff, density-cutoff, k-mesh, and vacuum variants plus the full-path mobility difference. Report a nonprobabilistic maximum-deviation envelope, not a confidence interval.
stages.atlas: Admit one independent mechanism with a nested temperature-rate curve and orthogonal barrier, saddle, prefactor, rate, and experimental tiers.

turnover_rule: No turnover claim or reconstruction is permitted without independently varied friction/damping and independent rate evidence.

electrostatic_convention.registered: ESM bc1 from the full clean-slab matrix through adsorption, endpoints, NEB, saddle, and sensitivity
